title: Define the project
description: Set the project scope, review precedent vehicles, and establish initial requirements.

title: Design the drone body
description: Develop and compare body concepts for flight, underwater movement, and 3D printing.

title: Select motors and propellers
description: Evaluate waterproof motors and propellers for the expected air and water operating conditions.

title: Simulate thrust and stability
description: Use simulation to estimate thrust, balance, and basic vehicle behavior in both environments.

title: Build the first prototype
description: Print the body, assemble the propulsion system, and prepare the electronics for testing.

title: Bench and water testing
description: Measure thrust, check waterproofing, and test controlled operation in water.

title: Integrate and demonstrate
description: Integrate controls and FPGA functionality, then demonstrate the complete vehicle.
